intro.heading: One POS system that runs
paragraphs: A modern restaurant POS system is far more than a cash register. It takes orders at the table, at the counter, via QR code and online, sends them straight to kitchen and bar, prints receipts, handles payments and gives you up-to-date sales figures at any time.

Liefro was built as a hospitality POS for the German market. The certified online TSE is already integrated, every transaction is signed, receipts are issued automatically and your POS data is stored in a GoBD-compliant way. You are ready for a cash register inspection without worrying about the technology.

Because Liefro is a cloud POS system, you can see sales, orders and reports from anywhere – in the office, at home or on your phone. Updates install automatically, and you manage multiple locations from a single account.

guide.heading: What to look for in a
guide.description: These points decide whether a restaurant POS saves you work or creates more of it.

items.title: Certified TSE and KassenSichV
items.text: In Germany, electronic tills must use a certified technical security device (TSE) and be registered with the tax office. Make sure the TSE is already integrated rather than extra hardware you have to buy.

items.title: Cloud instead of an isolated local system
items.text: A cloud POS makes your data available anywhere, installs updates automatically and is easy to extend with more devices or locations.

items.title: Every order channel in one till
items.text: Table orders, counter, QR code, pickup and delivery should all come together in the same POS. Duplicate entry and separate tablets cost time and cause mistakes.

items.title: Easy for the team
items.text: Staff change often in hospitality. A clear touch interface that makes sense in minutes saves training effort and stress during service.

items.title: Export for your tax advisor
items.text: POS data usually has to be kept for ten years. A DATEV-compatible export and a digital cash book make working with your tax advisor easier.

items.title: Personal support
items.text: When the printer fails on a Friday night, fast help is what counts. Ask about setup, training and reachable support.

faq.heading: FAQ about POS systems for restaurants

items.q: Which POS system is best for restaurants?
items.a: The best POS system for restaurants is one that fits your workflow: table plan, ordering at the table, kitchen receipts and online ordering in one system – with an integrated, certified TSE. Liefro combines exactly these features in one cloud solution.

items.q: Is Liefro a cloud POS system with TSE?
items.a: Yes. Liefro runs in the cloud and comes with a certified online TSE. You need no USB stick and no extra hardware – every transaction is signed automatically.

items.q: Is the POS system KassenSichV-compliant?
items.a: Liefro meets the KassenSichV requirements: certified TSE, receipt issuing and GoBD-compliant storage of POS data. We help you register your till with the tax office via ELSTER.

items.q: How much does a hospitality POS system cost?
items.a: The cost depends on the number of devices and the features you need. With Liefro, TSE, setup, training, support and updates are included in the package. You can find the current packages on our pricing page.

items.q: Can I manage several restaurants with one system?
items.a: Yes. With Liefro you manage multiple locations centrally – including menus, reports and staff. For franchises we are happy to put together a custom package.

items.q: How quickly is the POS system ready?
items.a: After the consultation we set up your menu, tables, printers and TSE and train your team. Many businesses are ready to go within a few days.

items.q: Do I need a TSE in my café?

items.q: Can guests order via QR code?

items.q: Can I issue receipts digitally?
